partners.mechanism_chain: NCF2 (HGNC:7734) —DISRUPTS→ Cytosolic Respiratory Burst Complex (GO:0007048); Cytosolic Respiratory Burst Complex (GO:0007048) —LEADS_TO→ Granulomatous disease, chronic, autosomal recessive, cytochrome b-positive, type 2 (MONDO:0009310); ATP6V1A (HGNC:775) —DISRUPTS→ Vacuolar H+-ATPase (GO:0005964); Vacuolar H+-ATPase (GO:0005964) —DECREASES→ Extracellular Matrix Remodelling (GO:0044274); Extracellular Matrix Remodelling (GO:0044274) —LEADS_TO→ Autosomal recessive cutis laxa type 2D (MONDO:0027451).
